Leah: DeployBot flagged renewal backoffs on mig_5333 during tenant-shard compaction at 22:11 UTC; auto-hold triggered.
DeployBot: [deploybot] RENEWAL_BACKOFF mig_5333 shard=shard-05 inflight=21/26 backoffs=4
Marco: seeing high PG lock waits on tenant_rows. risk of lease drop. Nadia, thoughts on quick mitigation?
Nadia: prefer cross-region handoff to avoid rollback; standby-azB has succeeded on similar spikes. fallback: selective pause + KV snapshot + pin tool version.
Oscar: agree. handoff first. If handoff fails -> snapshot then extend probe. rollback threshold: lease lost >40s OR inflight >28.
Leah: ok handoff to standby-azB then ratecap resume at 10%. pin migration tool to `infra/mig-stable-1.15.0`.
Marco: running: ```deploybot handoff mig_5333 --to standby-azB --actor marco```
DeployBot: HANDOFF_START mig_5333 -> standby-azB at 6012345682
DeployBot: HANDOFF_OK mig_5333 new_owner=standby-azB latency_spike=1.6s
Nadia: inflight dropped to 11, lock waits improving. applying ratecap 0.10.
Marco: ```deploybot ratecap mig_5333 --fraction 0.10 --actor marco``` -> acked
DeployBot: RATECAP_SET mig_5333 fraction=0.10 at 6012345692
Leah: Release notes draft: "mig_5333: cross-az handoff to standby-azB after lease backoffs; resumed at 10%; pinned infra/mig-stable-1.15.0; monitoring"
ReleaseBot: [releasebot] NOTE_PINNED mig_5333 tag=infra/mig-stable-1.15.0 by leah
Oscar: runtime snapshot hook captured KV prefix for the hot tenants just in case. checksum=sha256:def456
Nadia: good. probe extend not needed. keep thread open 20m, escalate to oncall if renewals spike.
Oncall: Reminder: if rollback executes, follow rollback-hatch and notify customer-success.
Leah: tnx all. closing after 20m stable.
